ValidationRule.description: Partner portal (travel agency) users may only fill Booking Reference. Required fields cannot be locked by field-level security, so this rule protects them.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL($User.UserType, "PowerPartner"), OR( ISCHANGED(Purpose__c), ISCHANGED(Trip_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Destination_City__c), ISCHANGED(Start_Date__c), ISCHANGED(End_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Estimated_Cost__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Travel agencies can only update the Booking Reference. Contact the employee to change trip details.
